mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand measured by HOUST coincides with stronger S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST growth exceeds +3% in the preceding month.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment reported by PAYEMS creates optimism about future earnings, driving S&P 500 forward returns positively over a 20-day horizon.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS monthly increase > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates weakening supply-side constraints, prompting a 60-day S&P 500 forward premium as growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns underperform a 5-day rolling average by more than 10 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the immediate 5-day S&P 500 forward return is negative due to higher discount rates applied to future earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are non-negative in all FEDFUNDS > 4% regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising unemployment (UNRATE < previous month) trigger a 20-day S&P 500 forward loss as risk aversion increases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive whenever UNRATE declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in both HOUST and GDPC1 (demand from consumption and business) creates a 60-day forward return positive effect for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero after controlling for individual HOUST and GDPC1 effects (multivariate Granger causality fails).

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (RSAFS > 800k and INDPRO < 95), the S&P 500 exhibits a 20-day forward premium as market anticipates inflation pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the supply shock conditions persisting for ≥ 2 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL accelerating), the S&P 500 shows negative 5-day forward returns as investors expect near-term rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly acceleration AND FEDFUNDS rising
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are non-negative whenever CPIAUCSL acceleration is not detected (CPIAUCSL monthly growth ≤ 0%).
